Meet Vinnie's on 11

Family flavors, fresh every day

Vinnie's on 11 is an Italian restaurant and pizzeria on Molly Pitcher Highway in Chambersburg, PA. Order at the counter and the food comes to your table; take-out and delivery run too, and there is a covered outdoor patio.

The boards carry the day: daily lunch specials served 10:30 to 2:00 (slices and a soda, half subs, lunch stromboli, spaghetti with meatballs), a printed wraps menu served with homemade chips, and dinner features like a seafood lasagna.
